description: Three-panel TEM composite of alloy M2-30. (a) Bright-field (BF) TEM micrograph with a 50 nm scale bar; a red arrow labelled "(Ti, V)C" points into a square boxed in purple, and a blue arrow labelled "κ Carbides" points to a blue-outlined box that is locally magnified in a lower inset showing striped/fringed contrast; purple dashed lines connect the purple box to (b). (b) HRTEM image (10 nm scale bar) of that purple-boxed region, showing a faceted, lens-shaped precipitate embedded in the matrix with two intergrown sets of lattice fringes and a periodic fringe/moiré pattern around it; a yellow square, linked by yellow dashed lines, marks the area used for the FFT in (c). (c) FFT (diffraction) pattern with the black frame/yellow border, showing the zone axis Z = [110] and indexed spots: yellow "(002) γ", blue "(002) (Ti, V)C" and red "(001) κ". No d-spacings or compositions are printed. Taken together the panels argue that (Ti, V)C and κ-carbide are intergrown in M2-30 and share the orientation relationship (002)(Ti,V)C || (001)κ.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph (50 nm scale bar) showing precipitates in the M2-30 matrix. A red arrow labelled "(Ti, V)C" points to a small dark particle enclosed by a purple square; a blue arrow labelled "κ Carbides" points to a blue-outlined box whose locally magnified inset (bottom) shows striped fringe contrast. Purple dashed lines indicate the region taken for the HRTEM in (b).

HRTEM image (10 nm scale bar) of the purple-boxed region in (a), framed in purple, showing a faceted precipitate with two intergrown sets of lattice fringes in a matrix; a yellow square with dashed lines marks the area used for the FFT in (c).
FFT pattern of the yellow-boxed region, labelled Z = [110], with indexed reflections (002) γ (yellow), (002) (Ti, V)C (blue) and (001) κ (red) marked by circles near the central beam.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM micrograph carrying a 50 nm scale bar.
In (a) a red arrow labelled "(Ti, V)C" points to a small dark particle enclosed by a purple square, and a blue arrow labelled "κ Carbides" points to a blue-outlined box.
Panel (a) contains a locally magnified inset (blue outline) in which striped/lattice-fringe contrast is visible; individual fringes are not resolvable at the supplied resolution.
Panel (b) is an HRTEM image with a 10 nm scale bar showing a faceted precipitate with two sets of lattice fringes surrounded by a periodic fringe/moiré contrast in the matrix.
Panel (c) is a Fast Fourier Transform (diffraction) pattern annotated with the zone axis Z = [110].
Panel (c) indexes reflection spots as (002) γ (yellow), (002) (Ti, V)C (blue) and (001) κ (red); the blue and red spots lie close together along nearly the same direction from the central beam.
The caption identifies (a) as the BF image of the precipitates in M2-30, (b) as HRTEM of the matrix and precipitates, and (c) as the FFT patterns image of precipitates and matrix.
The citing text states that Fig. 6 presents the (Ti, V)C carbides and κ-carbides in M2-30 at higher magnification.
The citing text states that panel (b) is the HRTEM of the region outlined in the purple box in (a) and demonstrates a typical intergrowth of κ-carbide and (Ti, V)C carbide.
The citing text states that, combined with the locally magnified image in (a), a linear alignment of κ-carbides occurs in the blue box.

The citing text states that the selected area contains the matrix, κ-carbide and (Ti, V)C carbide and that the FFT confirms the (002) plane of (Ti, V)C is parallel to the (001) plane of κ-carbide, denoted (002)(Ti,V)C || (001)κ.
No interplanar spacing (d-value), composition or particle-size number is printed anywhere in the figure; only Miller indices, phase symbols and the zone axis are annotated.
